data.street_address: Canada Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5AH

description.text:
Level up your look with the latest heat at JD. Switch it up with new in freshness from all your favourite brands... with hoodies, tees, tracksuits and more from the likes of Nike, adidas Originals, The North Face, Fila, PUMA and SikSilk. Keep a look out for JD-exclusives!

Serving up the latest styles from top brands, right here you'll find the hottest sneaker releases, as well as fresh colourways and JD-exclusive editions of all the old-school icons. Check out the latest from Nike with the VaporMax 2019, React Element and more, as well as retro styles from adidas Originals and PUMA's RS collection.

Giving you all the style inspo to get prepped for Spring, our I AM JD crew have you covered.

Location: Canada Place
